label: execute integration testing
_note: Two recall items and the full five-question mastery check.

items.question: What is the difference between a unit test and an integration test? Give one example of each from a web app.
items.modelAnswer:
A unit test checks one component on its own, with the parts it depends on replaced by fakes. An integration test checks that real components work together.

Example: a unit test calls validateEmail() with a bad address and expects false. An integration test submits the sign-up form and checks that a new row appears in the users table.

items.question: What is a stub, and why would you use one when you test two modules together?
items.modelAnswer:
A stub is a simple stand-in for a module that is not built yet, or that you do not want to call for real. In top-down integration testing, stubs take the place of the lower-level modules so you can test the module above them.

Example: you test the checkout page before the payment service exists, using a stub that always replies "payment accepted".
